headword: {高校野球|こうこうやきゅう}

definitions.explanation: Baseball played at the high school level in Japan. A hugely popular spectator sport, centered around the national tournament held at Koshien Stadium.

CULTURAL NOTE:
High school baseball holds a special place in Japanese culture. The two major national tournaments are held at ⟦{甲子園|こうしえん}→甲子園：23102_koushien⟧ ({阪神甲子園球場|はんしんこうしえんきゅうじょう}) in Hyogo Prefecture: the ⟦{選抜|せんばつ}→選抜：14494_senbatsu⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ (Spring Invitational) and the ⟦{選手権|せんしゅけん}→選手権：14432_senshuken⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ (Summer Championship). The summer tournament in particular draws enormous nationwide attention, with games broadcast live on NHK. It is often simply called ⟦{甲子園|こうしえん}→甲子園：23102_koushien⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{甲子園|こうしえん}→甲子園：23102_koushien⟧: Koshien — synonymous with the high school baseball tournament
- {球児|きゅうじ}: young baseball player — often used for high school baseball players
